content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for RWF Watcher Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: rwf.indianrailways.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 29-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Rail Wheel Factory (RWF) for filling up vacancies in its Vigilance Department through deputation from eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by RWF?
faq.answer: Rail Wheel Factory has advertised for the post of Watcher under the Vigilance Department for eligible candidates currently working in appropriate railway departments.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available for the Watcher post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Watcher post in Rail Wheel Factory under this specific notification number RWF/NG-39/891 Vol. II.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC / 10th standard and possess 5 years of regular service in the RPF department along with other required eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the offline application form is 29 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated address on time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for RWF Watcher recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to fill out the proforma and send it through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q7. To which address should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded through proper channel directly to The Chief Vigilance Officer, Vigilance Department, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bangalore-560 064.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RWF Watcher?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a screening test based on Service Register (SR) and APAR of the last 5 years, followed by a viva-voce test for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What salary scale is applicable for the Watcher position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary at Level-4 of RS(RP) Rules 2016 or one scale below i.e. Level-3 based on their service records and eligibility.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website for RWF?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the organization at rwf.indianrailways.gov.in to check detailed notifications, updates, and download necessary application proformas.
